title: Supply Metric0 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=supply:metric0
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day supply metric0 events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on supply metric0 events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It notices what time of day your supply metric0 feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
